verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists at modal.com/pricing, but the excerpts from it only cover workspace budgets, configurable timeouts, marketplace committed spend and startup or academic credits. No excerpt shows per-GPU-hour prices for any GPU type. The GPU docs list GPU types (A100-40GB, H100, H200, B200, B300) but give no prices, so the core of the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales
